about_the_game:
In a fantasy world, a simple misunderstanding sparked the most unnecessary war in history. Your mission isn’t to win it, but to survive it… from a train.

In Tracks n’ Turrets, forget static bases. Here, your base moves, and the battlefield changes from one second to the next. You are the commander of an improvised train—the only hope for the villages and cities along the path of this pointless conflict.

YOUR MISSION

In a fantasy world, a simple misunderstanding ignited the most unnecessary war in history. You won’t save the world. Caught in the middle of a completely pointless war between two ridiculous kingdoms, your only goal is to survive. Fortunately, the train comes with turrets.

STRATEGY ON RAILS

  • Moving Tower Defense:
    Place and upgrade your turrets while on the move. But beware—the landscape, enemies, and resources change every second! Reactive strategy is your greatest weapon.

  • One Train, Endless Possibilities:
    Customize your wagons. More cannons? More ballistas? Or a rear-mounted magic launcher to say goodbye to your pursuers? Every wagon is yours to shape your defense.

  • Deep Planning and Management:
    Between waves, enter the mobile workshop. Spend your resources wisely to buy new wagons, unlock more powerful turrets, and upgrade your train. Resource management is key to turning your train into an unstoppable fortress.

  • An Absurd and Charming Conflict:
    Dive into a campaign filled with eccentric characters, ridiculous kingdoms, and humor that lightens the tension of battle. Defend majestic capitals, picturesque farming villages, and strategic bridges while uncovering the hilarious and epic story behind this war.

INSPIRED BY THE BEST

Innovative moving TD gameplay, unpredictability and pacing, and the humor and action of chaotic comedies. Tracks n’ Turrets blends these ideas into a fresh, addictive experience full of personality.

All aboard!
Tracks n’ Turrets is coming soon to Steam. Add it to your wishlist and be the first to embark on this strategic adventure where mobility is both your greatest weapon and your biggest challenge. Don’t forget to join our Discord community to follow development closely!

short_description: The war moves with you! Tracks n' Turrets is a moving tower defense experience: protect cities, manage resources, and adapt your strategy in real time. In a chaotic fantasy world, your train is the last line of defense. Survive the most explosive journey!
